column1: # Where combat is multi-way (see osrsps.game.combat.MultiCombat). Tab-separated; tiles inclusive.
# Add a thread's areas as its content comes, with where each box came from.
# Barbarian Village: the OSRS Wiki says the entire village is multi-way. The box is the whole map square 48_53
# (region 12341), as 2004Scape's data/src/maps/multiway.csv has it; that live's box is the same is inferred.
# Stronghold of Security, floor 1 (the Vault of War): the OSRS Wiki says the first level is multi-way. The box is
# its whole map square 29_81 (region 7505), which holds no other floor; that the whole floor is multi-way is inferred.
# The Wilderness's multi-way areas on the surface (Wilderness step W4.4a): the OSRS Wiki's multicombat map,
# Module:DeadmanAnnihilationMulticombatZones.json (the map on its Multicombat area page, read 2026-11-15), its polygons
# filled tile by tile and cut into boxes. Inferred: that the map, drawn for Deadman Annihilation, is the main game's
# (it agrees with 2004Scape's multiway.csv on 81,371 of its 88,094 Wilderness tiles, and with the Wiki's list of
# Wilderness multi areas). Upper floors and caves are not on the map.
# Scorpia's cave under the Scorpion Pit (Wilderness step W4.4): the OSRS Wiki's Scorpion Pit says inside and outside
# are multi-way. Inferred: the whole of its map square, 50_161.
# The King Black Dragon's lair (Wilderness step W4.6): the OSRS Wiki's King Black Dragon Lair says it is multi-way.
# Inferred: the whole of its map square, 35_73.
# Scurrius's public lair in the Varrock Sewers (Scurrius step 1): its three by three zones, the sewage water's tiles
# with it. INFERRED multi-way: the Wiki's Scurrius has groups fighting him alongside his giant rats; the box is ours.
# The Escape Caves (Wilderness step W4.11): the OSRS Wiki's Escape Caves page calls them an underground multicombat area.
# The box is their whole map square 52_160 (inferred: live's box is the same).
# Callisto's Den (Wilderness step W4.12): the OSRS Wiki's Callisto's Den calls it multi-way. The box is its whole map
# square 52_161 on the ground level (inferred: live's box is the same).
# Vet'ion's Rest (Wilderness step W4.13): the OSRS Wiki's Vet'ion's Rest calls it multi-way. The box is its whole map
# square 51_159 on level 1 (inferred: live's box is the same).
# The Silk Chasm (Wilderness step W4.14): the OSRS Wiki's Silk Chasm calls it a multi-combat dungeon. The box is its whole
# map square 53_159 on level 2 (inferred: live's box is the same).
# The Corporeal Beast's Lair (Wilderness step W4.15): the OSRS Wiki's Corporeal Beast's Lair calls it a multi-combat area.
# The box is its whole map square 46_66 on level 2 (inferred: live's box is the same).
# The Wilderness Slayer Cave (Wilderness step W6.2): the OSRS Wiki's Wilderness Slayer Cave has it multi-combat throughout
# (Ice Barrage "in multi-combat", the cannon). The box is its map squares 52_157 to 53_158 on the ground level (inferred).
